summary: Blind rating of Composer output is scored against three named decks already on disk: the 09-02 source-native output as the floor, the customer's own source deck as parity, and the Hyundai SI reference deck as the design target.
invariants: Floor, must be beaten on every rated slide and not merely on average: output/candidate-54892244-dual-lane/preserve-43.pdf, with output/source-native-43-rc-20260902/source-native-43-fidelity.pdf as secondary.

Parity, must not be regressed against: the source deck itself rendered to PDF, deck-43 sourceDigest sha256:32b098831a84774dfc35820fed6e21e715259e2fc4e72e586a63c3fc650f1188 and deck-35; a restyle harder to read than the original is a regression whatever the template gains.

Target, the design bar proper: output/hyundai-reference-90plus-20260901/DevAX-SI-10slides-hyundai-reference.pptx with montage reference-first10-montage.png; it is the only tier that may be lost without failing the phase.
There is no authored comparator for verbatim restyle and there will not be one; any acceptance text asking for the best authored output on the same source is struck rather than approximated.

For ordinary generation the pinned authored comparator is authored-bounded-release-v3-final-20260823/product-attempt-21-head-4b89560-rev3-final/hybrid.pptx, fixed so the A/B does not drift onto a newer authored build mid-comparison.

Rating protocol: slide level, decks anonymised to A/B/C with page order preserved and pages aligned to the same source page across decks, at least 3 raters, 1 to 5 on five axes (legibility, information hierarchy, layout craft, deck level consistency, reads as designed rather than filled), score is the median.
Phase 1 acceptance: at or above the floor on every slide, at or above parity on legibility and consistency, and at least 80 percent of the target deck's median craft score.
The pixel feature scorer at output/hyundai-reference-90plus-20260901/evaluate_visual_system.py is a pre-filter for palette and density drift between rating rounds and is advisory only.
forbidden: Scoring a blind rating against an unnamed or newly chosen reference deck.
Passing phase 1 on an average that hides a slide rated below the floor deck.
Using the automated style conformance score as the acceptance gate.
Substituting a newer authored build for the pinned comparator during an in-flight comparison.
Padding or truncating the 10 page target deck to page-align it with the 43 page comparison; it is a craft calibration set on different content.
rationale: A blind rating needs named comparators rather than an adjective; all three tiers already exist on disk, so the bar is reproducible.
The floor deck is what this repository's own design document calls a text dump, so beating it on average would let a single bad slide through.
The customer already read the source page at its own size, which makes the source deck the only unarguable parity reference for a verbatim restyle.
The Hyundai reference deck is already used as this repository's fidelity reference and carries the craft the archetype library is aimed at.
The user decided on 2026-09-04 to proceed on this design bar after the proposal in section 7b of the design document.
